exposure: maternal preterm prelabour rupture of membranes (PPROM)
cohort: Term neonates (37 0/7-41 6/7 weeks gestational age) admitted to the NICU within 48 hours of birth at a tertiary care hospital in Karachi.
finding: Term NICU admissions were closely linked with modifiable perinatal factors, particularly early-term delivery, maternal complications (gestational diabetes mellitus and hypertension), and delivery practices.
mod_finding: Delivery mode, with 52% caesarean sections and 48% vaginal deliveries, was identified as a modifiable perinatal factor linked to term NICU admissions.
